versions.changelog:
No functional or content changes in this release.

- Version bump only; no file changes detected.  
- Skill documentation and functionality remain unchanged.
v1.0.0: Rewritten in English, character-consistent image generation, improved search keywords, added README
Rewrite SKILL.md in English, fix security scan issues, declare all env vars
Add optional --description param for id-photo (anime/virtual character support)
Prioritize generated ID photo over raw face reference
v0.0.5: Graceful download failure — downloadErrors in JSON instead of crash, SKILL.md with explicit output parsing and error handling guide for Agent
v0.0.4: Fix SSL handshake error on Python 3.9, add proxy support and SSL fallback for image downloads
v0.0.3: Added --output auto-download for all character commands, fixed 21KB image download issue, updated SKILL.md with download workflow
v0.0.2: Added persistent API key storage (.aurashot.env), updated SKILL.md with character creation workflow, multi-character management, and interactive role play guide
Initial release: AI character design skill with id-photo, character-generate, and edit capabilities
